honesty_rules: Show only what the record holds; a value the record does not hold renders as absent, never synthesized.
Defined-but-not-run experiments render as exactly that.
Weights and scores are read from the code and records at collection time, never transcribed from prose claims.
Workflow run counts are API observations stamped with their read time, not live claims.

data.method: Multivariate testing as practiced: simultaneous provider lanes over a live target (Team MVT), and schema-conforming loop experiments comparing a candidate ref against a baseline ref (the experiment loop). Arm designs come from the DoE library and arms execute under the ATES invariants — both cited below, owned by their surfaces.

experiment_record_schema.identity: canonical row identity is cohort x task x arm x repetition; each row retains task fingerprint, environment fingerprint, benchmark version, arm-factor hash, trace id, deterministic verdict, ATES metrics, and optional judge score

experiment_loop.mode: workflow_dispatch only; candidate and baseline refs are checked out independently, measured and recorded; it NEVER mutates refs

team_mvt.mode: simultaneous provider lanes over an issue/PR target; dispatched, issue-edited and master-push triggered; cadence owned by quota-dispatch-tree.yml (issue #1573)

citations.label: ATES harness — the seven hard invariants
citations.note: The invariants gate every arm MVT runs; they are ATES property, cited here, not copied.

citations.label: DoE design library
citations.note: full_factorial / taguchi_l9 / mvt_shuffle generate the arm designs MVT campaigns consume (doe.py: 'DoE helpers for MVT campaigns').

gaps: No committed experiment records conforming to EXPERIMENT.schema.json exist in the repo: the experiment loop has never been dispatched (0 runs observed), so there are no recorded MVT experiment results to rank or chart. Defined-but-not-run renders as exactly that.
